Dearest [Jay](/person/1042)
I find I have a copy of the [Shield](/book/184) which you are welcome to keep, I never did any more to the volumes than this, only imagined it. I found when I was half through the Shield that I had used the name of Merrifield before, in the [Stokesley Secret](/book/40). . .
